dashboard.label: AI Agent Health — conf26 Demo
dashboard.description: OBS1466: Your AI Is in Production. Who's Watching It? — model cost, latency, quality, and token usage across agent runs.

search.query: index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:metric cost_usd>0 | stats sum(cost_usd) as total_cost | eval total_cost="$" . tostring(round(total_cost,4))

index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:metric | eventstats max(demo_run_epoch) as latest_run | where demo_run_epoch=latest_run | stats avg(duration_ms) as avg_latency | eval avg_latency=tostring(round(avg_latency,0)) . " ms"

index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:metric | eventstats max(demo_run_epoch) as latest_run | where demo_run_epoch=latest_run | stats avg(quality_score) as avg_quality | eval avg_quality=tostring(round(avg_quality,2))
index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:metric | dedup demo_run_id | stats count as runs

index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:metric cost_usd>0 | dedup demo_run_id trace_id | stats sum(cost_usd) as run_cost by demo_run_id | eval run_cost=round(run_cost,4) | sort _time
index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:metric duration_ms>0 | dedup demo_run_id trace_id | sort _time | table _time demo_run_id duration_ms

index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:metric input_tokens>0 | dedup demo_run_id trace_id | stats sum(input_tokens) as input sum(output_tokens) as output by demo_run_id | sort _time

index=demo_ai_obs demo_name=ai_observability_conf26 sourcetype=ai:agent_event event_sourcetype=ai:metric | dedup demo_run_id trace_id | stats count as turns sum(cost_usd) as total_cost avg(duration_ms) as avg_latency avg(quality_score) as avg_quality sum(input_tokens) as in_tokens sum(output_tokens) as out_tokens by model_name | eval total_cost=round(total_cost,4), avg_latency=round(avg_latency,0), avg_quality=round(avg_quality,2) | sort -turns | rename model_name as Model turns as Turns total_cost as "Cost (USD)" avg_latency as "Avg Latency (ms)" avg_quality as "Avg Quality" in_tokens as "Input Tokens" out_tokens as "Output Tokens"
